items.heading: Most Comparisons of Canada Vs
items.text: Most Comparisons of Canada Vs Most Comparisons of Canada Vs Most comparisons of Canada vs Germany for masters India jump straight to rankings, weather, or which country "feels" more welcoming to Indian students. That framing skips the part that actually decides your outcome: what you study, what it costs you in total, and what happens to your visa status the day your program ends.

items.heading: This Is Where the Two
items.text: This is where the two countries diverge the most, and it is the part most agents summarise too quickly. Both give you real time to find work after graduation, but the rules underneath are different enough to change your entire plan.

items.heading: English Is the Working Language
items.text: English is the working language almost everywhere outside Quebec, so day-to-day life, job interviews, and networking do not require a second language.

items.heading: A Large Existing Indian Community
items.text: A large existing Indian community across Toronto, Vancouver, and other cities means familiar food, festivals, and social groups are easy to find from day one.

items.heading: The Main Adjustment Cost
items.text: The main adjustment cost is financial: higher rent, higher cost of living in the cities where most jobs concentrate, and a currency gap that makes even entry-level salaries feel tight against Canadian living costs at first.
